lines.say: Customer messages piling up? Just tell Claude.
lines.show: Customer DMs piling up? Just tell Claude.

lines.say: Step one. Open Claude and paste your shipping and returns policy.
Step two. Paste twenty customer messages from WhatsApp or Instagram.
Step three. Ask for a reply to each one, in your brand's voice.
lines.show: Step 3: a reply for each one.

lines.say: Angry customers and refund requests get flagged, so you answer those yourself.
lines.show: Angry ones and refunds get flagged.

lines.say: Read, copy, send. Twenty replies in about ten minutes.
Save this, and comment support for the exact prompt.
lines.show: Save this. Comment SUPPORT for the prompt.
